newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close tightly mixed, still in range.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close tightly mixed, still in range.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled mixed as prices maintained their recent sideways pattern, traders said.
May closed up 0.10 cent at 76.15 cents. Most-active July settled 0.20 cent per lb weaker 77.75 cents per lb, having traded from 80.75 to 77.40 cents.
Volume was estimated at 6,000 lots compared with Thursday's official 3,101 lots.
While the market has managed to hold its trading range for the last week, the outlook for juice futures remains negative.
Merrill Lynch analyst Judith Ganes said the market will remain focused on the weekly movement figures, which have left players disappointed for the past several weeks.

"Sales are not anticipated to increase much and in fact are entering the period of slower summer usage," Ganes said. "With retail prices staying relatively firm, there is little expectation for the demand scenario to change."
Technically, however, an oversold condition would prevent prices from easing as much as the fundamentals may warrant.
PaineWebber analyst Bernard Savaiko said the ability of May to move to a 1.90 premium over July from a 3.00 discount could signal a tightening of nearby phsical supply.
